title: Kith — AI Clinical Workspace for Therapists
excerpt: Private clinical workspace with AI-assisted SOAP notes and real-time session transcription.
content_html:
ITH

Built for therapists & clinical psychologists

Listen to patients,
not keyboards.

Ambient transcription, clinically specific SOAP notes, and scheduling — so every session goes to the patient, not the paperwork.

Kith

Today's Patients

PS

Priya Sharma

Anxiety · CBT

RM

Rahul Mehta

Depression · DBT

AI

Ananya Iyer

OCD · ERP

Selecting Priya Sharma…

Selecting patient

Everything around the session, handled

Ambient transcription

Kith listens in the background — in-person or online. No buttons to press mid-session.

Auto SOAP notes

Clinically specific notes ready within a minute of ending the session.

Online session bot

Sends a notetaker to your Google Meet automatically. Just admit it and talk.

Smart scheduling

Recurring sessions, conflict-free, with a live busy/free check.

Session reminders

15-minute in-app alert before every booked slot.

Clinical accuracy

Context-aware transcription — medication names and clinical terms come through correctly.

Plans & pricing

Start free. No card required.

Free

Free forever

$0

Get started

  • 5 sessions a month, 50 minutes each
  • AI-written clinical notes after every session
  • In-person session recording
  • Manage patients & appointments in one place

Pro

Per month

$20/mo

Get started

  • 60 sessions a month, 90 minutes each
  • Online sessions available — Kith joins the call and records it for you
  • Clinical notes ready once the session ends
  • Your calendar synced automatically — bring your own Teams/Zoom/Meet link

Most popular

Ultra

Per month

$50/mo

Get started

  • Unlimited sessions, 120 minutes each
  • Online sessions with in-session suggestions — homework and talking points update as the session progresses, in any supported language
  • A meeting link is created and emailed to the patient automatically for every online session
  • Message patients directly by email
  • Priority support — first in line when you need help

Encrypted at rest & in transit

PHI field-encrypted; audio deleted after transcription.

DPDP 2023 compliant

Built around India's data protection law from day one.

Row-level security

Each doctor only ever sees their own patients — never another's.

Ready to try Kith in your practice?

No card required. Cancel anytime.

Get started free
